notes.title: 16.08.2022 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Here is what we have changed:


Added the ability to jump.
Removed camera shaking.
Fixed a bug where you could get stuck near a lamp in the room with fire.

notes.title: ESCAPE IT RELEASE!
notes.content:
The game is now available for purchase to anyone! Try to Escape It now!

You can now purchase the game on its STORE PAGE!

If you need any help during your escape, we have made a COMPLETION GUIDE which has answers to all puzzles. If you are stuck or just bored you could use that to help you :)
